data.one_liner: Hive storage extension for the stash caching API
data.what_it_does: Provides support to store vaults and caches in the Hive database using binary msgpack serialization.
use_when: You are using the stash caching API and want to use Hive as the persistent storage backend.
You need high-performing binary serialization for cached items or vaults.
avoid_when: You are looking for a standalone Hive database implementation without the stash API wrapper.
You do not need caching features.
strengths: Integrates seamlessly with the stash caching ecosystem.
Relies on efficient msgpack binary serialization.
weaknesses: Requires managing dependencies for both stash and Hive.
data.setup_notes: Add stash_hive to pubspec.yaml and import the library along with stash.

alternatives.name: hive_ce
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a standalone, community edition of Hive without the stash wrapper.
